newsitem.title: NORWAY: Saga sees Vigdis oil restart this week.
newsitem.headline: Saga sees Vigdis oil restart this week.

text.p: Saga Petroleum ASA said on Monday it hoped to resume oil production at the North Sea Vigdis field some time this week.
When restarted, production at the development would be around 70,000 barrels per day (bpd), a spokeswoman for Saga told Reuters.
"We are going to start production this week, but it will more likely be towards the end of the week," the spokeswoman said.
Saga shut in Vigdis on July 17 following a series of problems in the gas compressor system, which saw production stop and start since April.
The field was pumping around 40,000 bpd before the latest shutdown. Since it came on stream on January 28, five months ahead of schedule, it has pumped around three million barrels.
Due to restrictions on gas flaring by Norwegian authorities, crude production at Vigdis is dependent on the gas compressor system.
